units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 93:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIII, 3</cite> (play on <he>דכים</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 93:2">ib.</cite>) <he>אני מְדַכְּאָן וכ׳</he> I will crush them (the Philistines) by means of severe afflictions.
Ib. וִידַּכְּאוּ ישראל וכ׳ and crush Israel by means of persecutions; a. e.—Part. pass. מְדוּכָּא, pl. מְדוּכָּאִין.
